about: Defects in markup or behaviour APEX itself renders, which no .apx can change. ux-check.py reports a finding that matches an entry, on the APEX version it names, as the advisory UX-ORACLE-OWNED instead of a FAIL. Each entry is narrow: one criterion, one rule or dialog step, a pattern every target must match, one APEX version. A new APEX version gets no entry until it is measured again. Never add a defect your own .apx causes.

entries.note: the Interactive Grid's own grid view: role=grid holding a role=region footer (.a-GV-footer) and a scroll div with tabindex (.a-GV-w-scroll)
entries.source: R-8, framework/CAPABILITIES.md Recorded runs (2026-10-13, APEX 26.2.0, axe-core 4.13.0)

entries.note: APEX's modal dialog: after Tab cycles inside the dialog, Esc returns focus to the opener or to <body> from one run to the next, with the same keys
